messages.subject: gbm updates
messages.body_plain:
Hi All!

It looks like we're getting into a state to be able to release a new gbm to CRAN.  Can anyone interested take a look at

https://github.com/gbm-developers/gbm

which should include Terry's Cox models, parallelized split searching, and refactoring of the C++ and R code?

I've flipped the maintainer from Harry to me; if anyone else wants the job do please shout!

Thanks,

--
pdm
